_about: Ethyl acetate (1) + ethanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa, binary data set from Calvar, Dominguez and Tojo (2005). Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: liquid mole fraction of ethyl acetate, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of ethyl acetate.

source.citation: N. Calvar, A. Dominguez, J. Tojo, Vapor-liquid equilibria for the quaternary reactive system ethyl acetate + ethanol + water + acetic acid and some of the constituent binary systems at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilibria 235 (2005) 215-222
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 10 (boiling temperature) and 11 (vapour mole fraction): the binary ethyl acetate + ethanol set. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Expanded uncertainties in the ThermoML record: T 0.18 K, y_1 0.015-0.024. Pure-component normal boiling temperatures in the same record: ethyl acetate 350.27 K, ethanol 351.43 K (not rows of this set). In the ThermoML record the compounds are numbered 1 acetic acid, 2 ethyl acetate, 3 water, 4 ethanol; the mole fractions are of compound 2 (ethyl acetate), which is the only reading consistent with the temperatures (x_1 -> 0 approaches the ethanol boiling point). Read twice from the ThermoML Archive (XML and JSON files), both reads identical in the numbers.
